definitions.gloss: appearing in succession, occurring one after another
definitions.explanation: Things of the same kind appearing or occurring repeatedly in quick succession. Often used for problems, incidents, or notable events that keep happening.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{続出|ぞくしゅつ}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Accidents are occurring one after another.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不祥事|ふしょうじ}→不祥事：14981_fushouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{続出|ぞくしゅつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}った→失う：01887_ushinau⟧。
examples.english: Scandals kept occurring one after another and trust was lost.

examples.japanese: ⟦{猛暑|もうしょ}→猛暑：08311_mousho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう}→熱中症：08330_necchuushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{続出|ぞくしゅつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Due to the extreme heat, heatstroke patients appeared one after another.

notes:
USAGE:
Typically used with negative or noteworthy events — accidents, scandals, problems, complaints. Can also be used neutrally for a series of notable occurrences. The pattern is subject + ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ + {続出|ぞくしゅつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

FORMS:
{続|ぞく} (continue, follow) + {出|しゅつ} (appear, emerge).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{頻発|ひんぱつ}→頻発：14670_hinpatsu⟧: occurring frequently
- ⟦{多発|たはつ}→多発：20508_tahatsu⟧: occurring in large numbers
- ⟦{相次|あいつ}ぐ→相次ぐ：14869_aitsugu⟧: to occur one after another (verb)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{続出|ぞくしゅつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: accidents occur in succession
- ⟦{苦情|くじょう}→苦情：00252_kujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{続出|ぞくしゅつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: complaints pour in
- ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{続出|ぞくしゅつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: damage cases keep appearing
- ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{続出|ぞくしゅつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: problems keep arising
